snippet.title: Ecos da Mata - Demo Gameplay Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Ecos da Mata is a top-down action-rpg game about preservation, colonialism and folklore. The story takes place in a fantasy setting inspired by Brazilian history and folklore, taking on its themes and characters. Play as Aiyra and uncover the mysteries of the Snoring Woods

The game is still unde development, subscribe and click on the bell to get all notifications from our channel
